comparison: Perfect agreement on K+ binding site characterization (C9, C10, C53-C55, C68-C70, C142-C145). Both evaluations find the evidence convincing, with peer reviewer specifically addressing and dismissing ionic strength concerns that OpenEval also noted were controlled for.

Strong agreement on K+ transport effects (C11-C12, C76-C82, C84-C86, C89-C92). Both confirm that intravesicular K+ increases transport velocity and that the effect is due to K+ per se, not gradients. Peer result additionally references C157 and C160 regarding mechanistic implications.

Complete agreement on tmFRET conformational data (C13, C58, C60-C64, C71-C75, C149-C151). Both evaluations accept that K+ stabilizes an outward-closed conformation and that the tmFRET approach is valid and high quality.

Full agreement on mutagenesis data identifying Na1 site involvement in K+ binding (C14-C16, C18, C94-C105, C109-C110, C113-C116). Both evaluations accept the comprehensive mutational analysis as supporting K+ binding to the Na1 site.

Agreement on conformational analysis of mutants (C117-C118, C120-C123, C126-C129, C131-C133, C137). OpenEval focuses on uncoupling of binding and conformational changes; peer review emphasizes overall data quality. Peer result includes additional claims C119, C130, C134-C136, C138 from other OpenEval results.

Agreement on Na1 site identification and mechanistic conclusions (C17, C19, C106-C108, C112, C136, C140-C141). Both accept that K+ binds to Na1 site and that mutations support this conclusion. Peer result also includes C162-C163 regarding conservation across transporters.
Complete agreement on competitive inhibition between Na+ and K+ (C50-C52). Peer reviewer explicitly states this is demonstrated 'convincingly,' matching OpenEval's supported evaluation.

Partial overlap on mutant transport function (C134-C135, C138). OpenEval evaluates these as supported functional data; peer review includes them within broader conformational analysis evaluation. Both accept the findings as high quality.

Partial overlap on non-functional mutants (C119, C125, C130). OpenEval treats these as important negative controls (supported); peer review includes C119 and C130 within broader mutant conformational analysis without specific comment on the negative results.

Agreement on uncertainty regarding Na+/leucine FRET interpretation (C65-C67, C153-C154). Both evaluations find this speculative or uncertain. OpenEval notes contradiction with crystal structures; peer review notes lack of explicit reviewer comment on this specific finding.

Agreement on directionality characterization (C93). OpenEval finds it supported but somewhat qualitative; peer review implicitly accepts it as adequate through acceptance of sidedness effects without raising concerns.

Agreement on mechanistic model (C155-C161). OpenEval rates as uncertain, noting explicit speculation by authors; peer review rates as supported, with editor affirming the proposed mechanisms. Divergence reflects different standards for speculative vs. reasonable mechanistic interpretations.

Partial overlap on conservation across transporters (C162-C165). OpenEval finds conservation claims well-supported by convergent evidence; peer review includes C162-C163 within broader Na1 site mechanism evaluation and implicitly accepts conservation arguments.

OpenEval evaluates background/literature claims (C1-C49) as supported. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, as reviewers typically do not explicitly evaluate established background knowledge.

OpenEval evaluates methodological foundation claims (C56-C57, C59, C147-C148) as supported. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, though peer reviewer's acceptance of tmFRET data quality implicitly validates the methodology.

Minimal overlap on Rb+ effects (C64, C71, C77, C152). OpenEval treats Rb+ data as separate supported result; peer review includes C64 and C71 within broader tmFRET conformational analysis (R3) and C77 within transport effects (R2), accepting findings without specific comment on Rb+.

OpenEval identifies explicitly speculative statements (C83, C124, C146) as uncertain. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; reviewers did not separately evaluate these acknowledged speculations.
